terms.gloss: out of breath, exhausted; also half dead with fright
evidence: Plaut. Asin. 265: exanimātus currit hūc Leōnida
Caes. BG 2.23.1: cursū ac lassitūdine exanimātī (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: The participle of exanimō, take the breath (anima) out of.

phrases.latin: sed quid illuc, quod exanimātus currit hūc Leōnida?
phrases.english: but what’s this? Leonida running here out of breath?

phrases.latin: nimis male timuī. Prius quam intrō rediī, exanimātus fuī.
phrases.english: I was dreadfully frightened. Before I got back inside, I was half dead.
